description: Your BMW's telemetry, on the command line — device-code login, live telematic snapshots, charging history, and a local SQLite store that turns raw VSS data into trends, cost, and fleet insight no other tool gives you.

novel_features.name: SoC/range trends
novel_features.description: See your battery state-of-charge and derived range as a time series you can chart.

novel_features.name: Charging cost & efficiency
novel_features.description: Reconcile your charging sessions against your electricity tariff and see DC charge efficiency.

novel_features.name: Quota tracker
novel_features.description: See how many of your ~50 daily API calls you have spent and when the budget resets (midnight UTC).

novel_features.name: Fleet status
novel_features.description: One table of current SoC, range, charging state and last location across every vehicle on your account.

novel_features.name: Descriptor search
novel_features.description: Search the VSS telematic descriptor catalogue (e.g. batteryManagement, charging, navigation) to build containers.

novel_features.name: Battery health
novel_features.description: Track battery capacity degradation by comparing observed max energy against the nameplate capacity.

novel_features.name: Snapshot diff
novel_features.description: Show exactly what changed between two telematic snapshots (windows, charging, locks, location).

novel_features.name: Trip reconstruction
novel_features.description: Reconstruct trips (start, end, elapsed, distance) from your vehicle's location breadcrumbs.
